admission: Primary papers and official NASA material; selected methods/results inspected through web retrieval, not a claim of full scholarly admission. No external full-paper bytes added.

sources.title: Giant Vehicles
sources.authors: Magdi A. Said, Willi W. Schur, Amit Gupta, Gary N. Mock, Abdelfattah M. Seyam, Thomas Theyson
sources.access: NASA record and design sections of PDF pp.4-9 inspected
sources.supports: Hydrostatic apex pressure and spherical strength grow with size; lobed skins use local curvature while tendons carry global loads.
sources.limit: Engineered stratospheric balloon architecture, not living tissue or lunar validation. Current formulas are separately derived ideal screens.

sources.title: Material Properties Analysis of Structural Members in Pumpkin Balloons
sources.access: PDF abstract, introduction and test-method sections inspected
sources.supports: Braided PBO cord strength below direct fibre scaling; slow-rate, temperature and age effects matter.
sources.conditions: Braided high-modulus PBO balloon tendons; experiments from ambient temperature to 183 K and different strain rates.
sources.limit: No fibre-to-living-tendon strength transfer adopted. 100 MPa allowable in this study is a hypothesis.

sources.title: Non-Linear Analysis of the NASA Super Pressure Balloons: Whole Flight Simulations
sources.supports: Viscoelastic film, thermal history, fabrication details and tendon-sleeve interactions are part of actual balloon analysis.
sources.limit: Not a source of numerical biological-film properties.

sources.title: Relative humidity and temperature modify the mechanical properties of isolated tomato fruit cuticles
sources.authors: Antonio J. Matas, Gloria Lopez-Casado, Jesus Cuartero, Antonio Heredia
sources.observed: Wet strength approximately 21 MPa below and 14 MPa above temperature-transition range. Warmth/hydration lower strength and stiffness.
sources.limit: Excised millimetre cuticles screened for cracks; 20-minute step loading does not establish years-long allowable strength or giant assembled tissue.

sources.title: Antioxidant and UV-Blocking Leather-Inspired Nanocellulose-Based Films with High Wet Strength
sources.access: Primary abstract, preparation and test-method sections, Table 1 and water-uptake result inspected
sources.limit: Engineered nonliving film; no hydrogen permeability, seams, biological synthesis or lifetime creep validated. Density 1500 kg/m3 and allowance 0.1–10MPa are study sensitivities.

sources.title: Strengths of balloon films with flaws and repairs
sources.supports: Biaxially loaded polyethylene cylinders used to assess flaws/repairs.
sources.limit: No empirical tear rate or healing rate imported.

sources.title: Mass Flow Rate Equations
sources.supports: Compressible gas-flow dependence and choking require an appropriate high-speed model.
sources.limit: The Cd 0.6 small-overpressure puncture diagnostic is explicitly assumed, not an experiment on living membrane holes.
